instruction: Can you reduce the maximum volume in VLC to 100 percent? I want to prevent accidentally setting the volume too high and damaging my speakers.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the maximum volume setting in VLC to 100%. The evaluator checks if qt-max-volume is set to 100 in the VLC configuration file. Similar configuration task with different target value than variation 1.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_qt_max_volume metric function. Expected value: qt-max-volume=100 in vlcrc configuration file.

Metric handles default value correctly (125 is VLC's default) and will properly fail if setting not changed
